---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
output: html_document
params:
  datalist: NULL
  stock: NULL
  dose: NULL
  well.vol: 230
  tissue: "liquid"
  title: "N2a Dose-Response Report"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5)
```

## Per-plate dose-response
```{r plots, results='asis'}
all_rows <- list()
for (i in seq_along(params$datalist)) {
  pid <- names(params$datalist)[i]
  cat("\n\n### ", pid, "\n\n")
  cat("<div style='display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px;'>\n")

  cat("<div style='flex:1;'>\n")
  invisible(capture.output(
    row <- n2a::n2dr(params$datalist, stock = params$stock, dose = params$dose,
                     well.vol = params$well.vol, tissue = params$tissue, subset = i)
  ))
  all_rows[[i]] <- row
  cat("</div>\n")

  cat("<div style='flex:1;'>\n")
  print(knitr::kable(
    data.frame(
      Parameter = c("EC50", "max", "min", "Hillslope", "OV %", "Converged"),
      Value = c(round(row$EC50,3), round(row$max,1), round(row$min,1),
                round(row$Hillslope,3), round(row$OV_pct,1), row$converged)
    ),
    format = "html", row.names = FALSE
  ))
  cat("</div>\n")

  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
results <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
```

## All plates

```{r table}
knitr::kable(results, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```
